notes.title: Demo Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
-Fixed level not actually being capped at 25.
-Fixed a bug where you could endlessly pick up health and shield pickups by repeatedly walking over the same area.

[b]Changes:[/b]
-Raised level cap from 25 to 50.
-Lowered max damage, max rate of fire, max mag size, and starting mag size for each weapon.
-Re-adjusted the amount you get per point for above attributes.
-Lowered the initial speed of the bomber enemy.
-Lowered enemy punch damage.

That's all for now =)

notes.title: Demo update 1.1
notes.content:
Just a small update to the demo.

-Added info text on the screen for health and shield pickups.
-Health and shield pickups can't be picked up when they are full.
-Added a new ranged enemy.

That's all for now!
Take care =)
